description.value: A voxel-based morphometry study of grey and white matter volume differences between heavy cannabis users and healthy controls, and associations with cannabis use and dependence.

spans.text: The goal of the current sMRI study was to investigate structural brain alterations in relation to levels of cannabis use and severity of dependence in a large sample, taking into account the use of addictive substances other than cannabis.
